sourceCopy.title: Ludo Game Online Free | Play vs Computer | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Play Ludo online for free: roll, move four tokens, capture on unsafe squares, and race home against local bots or pass-and-play. No sign-up.
sourceCopy.intro: Play a local Ludo race game with two to four players. Choose a token after each roll, use safe squares, capture opponents, and reach home with exact rolls.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do you play this Ludo game?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Choose two to four players and optional computer opponents. Roll the die; a six releases a token from base. Move a legal token along the track, avoid capture on unsafe squares, and enter the home lane. This casual rule set requires an exact roll to finish.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Is this Ludo game online multiplayer?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. You can play on one device in pass-and-play or against simple bots in this browser. Moves are not uploaded and no account or sign-up is needed.
howTo: Choose the number of players and optional local bots, then start a game.
Roll the die. Roll a six to bring a token out of base; select one of the highlighted legal tokens.
Capture on unsafe squares, use safe squares, and reach the finish with an exact roll. A six, capture, or finish grants another roll in this casual rule set.

fields.rules: Casual rules: six to leave base; start and star squares are safe; six, capture, and exact finish grant another roll. No triple-six penalty or blockade rule. Regional rules vary.
fields.accuracyNote: This is a local pass-and-play game or a game against simple computer opponents. It is not online multiplayer. Moves stay in this browser tab and are not saved.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I play Ludo against the computer?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Choose one or more local computer opponents. The bot uses a simple legal-move priority and does not connect to a service.

additionalFaqs.question: What are the safe squares in this version?
additionalFaqs.answer: Each player start and the four marked star squares are safe. Tokens on a safe square cannot be captured. Ludo house rules vary by region.

additionalFaqs.question: Does a token need an exact roll to finish?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. This version requires the exact number to reach the final home space; an overshooting roll does not move that token.
